analyst_view.overall: Early view: Genclerbirligi (14th) host bottom side Eyupspor, who have three points and a 3-30 goal difference under Mustafa Dalci. Bernd Storck's team showed what they can do at Eryaman with a 5-0 win over Alanyaspor; Diabate and Metehan Baltaci, listed as missing here, should have served their bans in the Gaziantep game, so their status needs rechecking.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals and I lean higher. Genclerbirligi's expected 1.5 looks low against a defence that has conceded 30, and they scored five at home to Alanyaspor, so I see them scoring two or more with little coming back from Eyupspor.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Genclerbirligi should do most of the attacking, which fits the 5.6 to 4.1 split, and nothing moves the total.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. Genclerbirligi had a red card and a fifth-yellow ban in the Besiktas game, but this should be a game they control, so I stay near four.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.4 shots. I expect more from Genclerbirligi and fewer from Eyupspor than forecast, which roughly cancels out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. Genclerbirligi's attackers should test the keeper often, but Eyupspor's 4.0 looks high for a team with three goals all season, so the total stays close to nine.
